rules.statement: Every mechanical or structural change shall trigger a flight-simulation impact assessment and shall update the applicable OpenRocket or RocketPy model when a flight-driving input changes.
required_assessment: recovery geometry, drag, deployment events, and deployment loads
whether numerical simulations must be rerun
rules.no_update_rule: A no-update disposition requires a committed change-impact record with deterministic comparison evidence and explicit rerun criteria.

rules.statement: Every electronics hardware change shall trigger a mechanical packaging and interface impact assessment and shall update the CAD model, allocations, or mechanical interface records when an envelope changes.
required_assessment: mounting holes, supports, fasteners, and stack interfaces
mass and center of gravity contribution
connector access, cable routing, and bend radii
power dissipation, cooling path, and insulation
antenna, RF keep-out, sensor port, and optical window constraints
assembly, removal, vibration, and shock clearances
rules.no_update_rule: A no-update disposition requires a committed change-impact record identifying the reviewed electronic revision and the mechanical clearance evidence.
